card.name: Linking words in natural history writing
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (and, of, comma, colon) in text about naturalists and natural history, often just before a naturalist's or species name. It fires where a zoological name or author is expected next.

modes.label: Linking word after naturalist
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'of' between names of naturalists or their works.
modes.example: furnish information from which the works of Pennant<< and>> Barrington largely profited

modes.label: Author after species name
modes.description: An 'of' or comma after a species name, where the naming authority comes next.

card.plain: It marks small joining words in writing about naturalists and animal species, where a species name or author comes next.
